items.headline: Pritzker signs bills allowing Illinois to review insurance rate hikes
items.summary: The new laws give the Insurance Department rate review authority for homeowners, auto policies.

items.headline: Iowa DNR investigating wastewater discharge that reached Mississippi River in Keokuk
items.summary: Repairs are underway. Those using the river recreationally downstream should use extra caution and avoid the area, the Iowa DNR recommended.

items.headline: 3 children from the Quad Cities area have been selected as 2026 University of Iowa Health Care Kid Captains
items.summary: Our local captains include Harlow Taube of Orion, JJ Ward of Davenport and Ellie Walker of Clinton.

items.headline: Person killed in crash outside of Tipton, Iowa
items.summary: One person died after a crash involving a car and a semi-truck Monday morning near Tipton. The Iowa State Patrol is investigating.

items.headline: Iowa Libertarian Party: 3rd District candidate Marco Battaglia ends campaign due to health
items.summary: In late July, a Polk County judge upheld a state panel decision that Battaglia could not be on the November ballot due to his legal name being Mark Andersen.
